mobility: For each actor pair of rows: first row columns1-4 idle breathing/ready loop four subtle phases, columns5-8 running four clearly distinct stride phases (contact,down,passing,up). Second row columns1-4 low crouch walk four phases, columns5-8 jump four phases (takeoff,rise,apex,fall).
combat: For each actor pair of rows: first row columns1-4 firing weapon four phases (aim,trigger/recoil,recover,ready), columns5-8 close combat four distinct phases (windup, strike, followthrough, recover). Second row columns1-4 reacting to hit four phases (impact,flinch,stagger,recover), columns5-8 non-gory falling defeated four phases (stagger,knees,fall,lying on ground). Exactly one character in each cell, no opponent. Do not duplicate poses. No blood.

roster.mg1: A young Solid Snake in original Metal Gear MSX 1987 Outer Heaven design: olive green field fatigues, dark web harness and belt, short brown hair and green bandana, black boots, compact handgun, no beard eyepatch horn or futuristic armor. B Outer Heaven regular soldier: tan olive uniform, brown field belt, olive steel helmet and black boots, AK rifle. C Outer Heaven elite reinforcement: dark green combat fatigues, olive helmet and heavier dark webbing, AK rifle; period Cold War kit, no modern plates.
roster.mg2: A Solid Snake in Metal Gear2 Solid Snake 1990 Zanzibar Land design: olive green combat fatigues and headband, brown short mullet hair, dark webbing, black boots, handgun, no beard eyepatch horn. B Zanzibar Land soldier in olive drab fatigues, olive helmet, brown web equipment and AK rifle. C Zanzibar elite reinforcement in darker olive fatigues, balaclava and dark green helmet, substantial olive vest and AK rifle. Strict late Cold War military kit.
roster.mgs1: A Solid Snake from MGS1 (2005 Shadow Moses): young brown hair and dark bandana, fitted blue-gray sneaking suit, dark chest harness, black gloves and boots, NO beard/eyepatch/horn/cyborg armor, suppressed SOCOM pistol. B MGS1 Genome soldier: gray-white winter camouflage fatigues, dark tactical vest, gray balaclava and helmet, black boots, FAMAS bullpup rifle. C MGS1 Genome Arctic Trooper reinforcement: white arctic camouflage jacket and pants, gray reinforced tactical vest, white balaclava and white military helmet with dark goggles, black gloves and boots, FAMAS rifle. White arctic silhouette clearly distinct from B gray camouflage. Characters are original fan-made renditions of their correct PS1-era designs.
roster.mgs2_tanker: A Solid Snake MGS2 Tanker 2007: blue-gray sneaking suit with dark padded vest and shoulder panels, dark blue bandana, brown mullet, short brown stubble, black gloves boots, suppressed USP pistol, no eyepatch/horn. B Gurlukovich Russian mercenary Tanker: rain-darkened olive camouflage, olive balaclava and cap, black web vest, AKS-74U carbine. C Gurlukovich heavy backup soldier: olive rain fatigues, black balaclava, olive helmet and heavy vest, AKS-74U, authentic MGS2 not modern futuristic armor.
roster.mgs2_plant: A Raiden MGS2 Plant 2009 HUMAN version: slim athletic young man, longish platinum blond hair, tight dark blue-gray skull sneaking suit with segmented gray torso panels, black boots/gloves, SOCOM pistol. NO cyborg jaw, no red eye, no white metal body, not Revengeance. B Gurlukovich Big Shell guard: olive brown camo fatigues, balaclava and helmet, dark vest, AKS-74U. C Arsenal Gear Tengu commando MGS2: blue-black exoskeletal ninja combat armor, masked angular full helmet, small orange visor, dark boots, short rifle and sheathed sword, keep MGS2 proportions.
roster.mgs3: A Naked Snake MGS3 Operation Snake Eater1964: brown short mullet, olive bandana, subtle beard, olive woodland tiger stripe camouflage field uniform, dark suspenders and belt pouches, dark boots gloves, M1911A1 pistol, NO horn prosthetic arm or futuristic armor. B Ocelot Unit soldier1964: maroon-red beret, black balaclava, dark olive Soviet field fatigues with black webbing, AK rifle. C GRU heavy soldier1964: bulky tan olive quilted Soviet uniform, old gas mask and steel helmet, dark chest webbing, machine gun, no modern helmet optics.
roster.mgs4: A Old Snake MGS4 2014: visibly aged face with gray moustache, gray swept hair and bandana, blue-gray segmented tight OctoCamo suit with dark chest rig, Solid Eye patch on LEFT eye, black boots gloves, suppressed pistol. No horn or prosthetic arm. B Middle Eastern PMC soldier MGS4: tan desert uniform, olive brown tactical vest, tan helmet with goggles, black boots, assault rifle. C FROG Haven trooper MGS4: athletic female silhouette in black gray fitted tactical exosuit, smooth full white-gray helmet and red small visor detail, P90 compact bullpup. No exposed face or sexualized outfit.
roster.peace_walker: A Big Boss in Peace Walker Costa Rica1974: brown mullet and beard, dark olive bandana, black eyepatch over RIGHT eye, olive green MSF jungle fatigues, web harness and dark gloves/boots, tranquilizer pistol. Both arms organic, no horn. B Peace Sentinel soldier1974: olive Central America jungle fatigues, green steel helmet, simple green chest harness, rifle. C Peace Sentinel heavy soldier1974: thick green padded jacket, military helmet and face mask, bulky dark flak vest, machine gun. No futuristic optics or cyborg armor.
roster.mgsv_ground_zeroes: A Big Boss Ground Zeroes Camp Omega1975: brown mullet and beard, dark bandana, RIGHT eyepatch, dark black-gray close-fitting sneaking suit with ribbed chest and harness, both arms organic, NO shrapnel horn, suppressed tranquilizer pistol. B XOF covert soldier Ground Zeroes: gray-black tactical uniform, dark helmet, respirator mask and black harness, rifle. C XOF heavy reinforcement: charcoal combat uniform, helmet full face gas mask, bulky dark vest and pads, rifle. No futuristic cyborg designs.
roster.mgsv_phantom_pain: A Venom Snake MGSV The Phantom Pain1984: brown swept mullet/ponytail and beard, RIGHT eyepatch, small shrapnel horn on forehead, RED LEFT prosthetic arm, olive-brown desert combat fatigues and tactical harness, black gloves boots, tranquilizer pistol. Distinct Venom identity. B Soviet Afghanistan soldier1984: dusty khaki Afghanka uniform, tan cap, brown belt/chest pouches, AK rifle, no modern armor. C Skulls Parasite Unit armored commando: pale gray stony mineral skin/armor, dark tactical torso, covered angular head with respirator-like mask, rifle, inhuman sinewy silhouette, no giant robot.
roster.vr_simulation: A VR operative modeled on young MGS1 Solid Snake: blue-gray stealth suit, brown hair dark bandana, black harness gloves boots, pistol, restrained green digital rim light. B MGS Integral VR simulated guard: faceless dark gray-blue combat uniform helmet vest, compact rifle, cyan rim light. C advanced VR guard same virtual training design with heavier charcoal vest and helmet, amber rim accents, rifle. Original VR simulation variants faithfully based on MGS1 Integral low-poly silhouettes, not canon new characters.
roster.patriots_ai: A Raiden MGS2 Arsenal Gear HUMAN version: slim young adult, platinum blond hair, dark gray-blue fitted skull sneaking suit, dark boots gloves, SOCOM pistol, subtle cyan digital glitch edge confined to body. No cyborg jaw or Revengeance armor. B corrupted Arsenal security guard derived from MGS2 Gurlukovich olive military fatigues, helmet balaclava and rifle, tiny green scanline accents. C corrupted Tengu commando MGS2 dark navy gray exoskeletal armor, angular masked helmet with orange visor, compact rifle and sheathed sword, tiny green scanline accents. Glitch does not obscure canonical silhouettes.
